items.title: ‘How Could You Not?’ Says Investor About Sandisk Stock
items.summary: Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) is selling flash memory to AI data centers about as fast as it can make it, but that has done little for investors’ morale recently. The stock keeps falling anyway, with shares drifting lower since their late-June peak. The past couple of weeks have made things worse. AI stocks dropped after the Democrats’ midterm sweep raised fears that tighter rules could slow data center construction, and then fell again when Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on Nov. 12.
